name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of the Projected No-Clashing Teaching Separation Class
proof: Assign respectively to $0000,0001,0010,0011,0100,1101$ the one-example samples $(2,0),(3,1),(3,0),(2,1),(1,1),(0,1)$. Every pair avoids a clash under this map, proving the upper bound; a class with more than one concept cannot have NCTD zero. The calculation is also checked by sync/verify_projected_noclashing_gap.py.
